evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Specifies search by content identification/fingerprinting, which is a distinct method compared to other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Focuses on personalization via user profile, a different approach than other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Uses collaborative filtering / similarity to other users, distinct from profile- or content-based search.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Requires content-similarity to a given video and supports ringback tones—different goal and context.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Specifies use of enriched metadata and image tags for discovery, distinct technical/business rule.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Concerns upload workflow and tag persistence, not a search/discovery requirement—distinct concern.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Displays thumbnail sequences of segments—unique UI/visualization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: General 'similar' video info; other story (ZO-009) refines similarity as 'perceptual' which is a meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: 'Perceptually similar' narrows the type of similarity and is a meaningful difference from generic similarity requirements.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Specifies recommendations derived from similar profiles, differing from event- or news-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations tied to local news events—distinct data source and business rule from profile-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Entity type 'persons' is specific and distinct from other detection/identification stories (products, logos, brands).

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Targets product identification, which is a different detection/classification goal than persons or logos.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is a distinct recognition task and business need compared to persons/products/brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification has its own scope and is distinct from logos/products/person identification.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation flow is a specific feature distinct from search or content-based discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geolocation/map-based discovery is a distinct context and interaction model.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a specific technical approach different from other search requirements.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin-facing editing and validation of segmentations is a unique operational requirement.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Task is news-segment annotation with topic extraction—distinct content and outcome from other admin tasks.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct ranking metric and business rule.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio edit-detection is a distinct quality assessment requirement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Specifies a specific content category/business rule (nudity) for prefiltering, which is meaningfully different from generic prefilter stories.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering based on low-level asset features is a technical approach distinct from high-level metadata or specific content categories.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright infringement validation is a legal/compliance requirement distinct from other filtering or classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering via high-level metadata/tags contrasts with low-level asset-based prefiltering and is a distinct rule/approach.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Combines multiple data sources for subjective assessment; unique composite requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Triggers prompting scientists based on annotations/comments—a distinct decision rule and actor interaction.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer typology identification is a distinct classification requirement used for different downstream actions.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Domain-specific (Galaxy Zoo) preclassification using low-level features—distinct project and technique.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific task for Snapshot Serengeti; other similar tasks target different projects (Plankton), so distinct.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Handles timestamp malfunction detection, a unique error-correction/preprocessing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification in a specific project is distinct from other classification tasks (plankton, Galaxy Zoo).

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., age/sex/activity) differs from species or count detection—distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct analytic goal from species/attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Automatic segmentation/localization for plankton is project- and technique-specific and distinct from admin editing of segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Analogous detection as ZO-031 but for Plankton Portal; different dataset/project is a meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a specific measurement task distinct from species/segmentation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification in Plankton Portal is project-specific and differs from size/orientation and segmentation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific video reduction via worm motion analysis is a unique preprocessing/use-case requirement.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a distinct analytical target from motion-based video reduction.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Satellite imagery feature detection is a distinct domain and set of target features.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weights based on volunteer experience is a unique trust/aggregation metric requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artifact removal from images is a specific preprocessing goal distinct from content-based prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct analytic capability not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a specific processing task distinct from classification or edit-detection.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping of whale calls is a clustering task distinct from counting or other audio analyses.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a distinct measurement requirement separate from grouping similar calls.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining interruption timing is a distinct decision compared with educating or content modality selection.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Specifies modality choice for interruption—different requirement than knowing when to interrupt or educate.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining when to educate differs in intent from interrupting; different action and business rule.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Modality selection for education is a separate requirement from modality for interruption or from deciding which education to give.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selection of specific educational content is distinct from timing or modality decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is a monitoring/alerting requirement separate from Zoonibot actions.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Determining when Zoonibot should comment is a timing/trigger decision specific to the bot's role.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Timing for explanations by Zoonibot is a different action (explain) than commenting—meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Concerns the content of Zoonibot messages (what to say) rather than timing or action type—distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject grouping/clustering is a general organizational requirement distinct from other grouping tasks tied to specific media or projects.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation for volunteers is a distinct recommendation target and actor from content recommendations to users.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a unique content-processing requirement not duplicated elsewhere.
